content: The word of the Lord that came to Hosea son of Beeri during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz and Hezekiah, kings of Judah, and during the reign of Jeroboam son of Jehoash king of Israel:

teaching.name: Marriage of Hosea and Gomer

content: In that day I will break Israel’s bow in the Valley of Jezreel.”

teaching.name: Marriage of Hosea and Gomer

content: Then the Lord said, “Call him Lo-Ammi, for you are not my people, and I am not your God.

teaching.name: Marriage of Hosea and Gomer

content: The people of Judah and the people of Israel will come together; they will appoint one leader and will come up out of the land, for great will be the day of Jezreel.

teaching.name: Marriage of Hosea and Gomer

content: Then the Lord said to Hosea, “Call him Jezreel, because I will soon punish the house of Jehu for the massacre at Jezreel, and I will put an end to the kingdom of Israel.

teaching.name: Marriage of Hosea and Gomer

content: “Yet the Israelites will be like the sand on the seashore, which cannot be measured or counted. In the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ they will be called ‘children of the living God.’

teaching.name: Marriage of Hosea and Gomer

content: Yet I will show love to Judah; and I will save them—not by bow, sword or battle, or by horses and horsemen, but I, the Lord their God, will save them.”

teaching.name: Marriage of Hosea and Gomer

content: When the Lord began to speak through Hosea, the Lord said to him, “Go, marry a promiscuous woman and have children with her, for like an adulterous wife this land is guilty of unfaithfulness to the Lord.”

teaching.name: Marriage of Hosea and Gomer

content: So he married Gomer daughter of Diblaim, and she conceived and bore him a son.

teaching.name: Marriage of Hosea and Gomer

content: Gomer conceived again and gave birth to a daughter. Then the Lord said to Hosea, “Call her Lo-Ruhamah, for I will no longer show love to Israel, that I should at all forgive them.

teaching.name: Marriage of Hosea and Gomer

content: After she had weaned Lo-Ruhamah, Gomer had another son.

teaching.name: Marriage of Hosea and Gomer
Israel will become an empty vine

content:
Then they will say, “We have no king
    because we did not revere the Lord.
  But even if we had a king,
    what could he do for us?”

teaching.name: Israel will become an empty vine

content:
The high places of wickedness will be destroyed—
    it is the sin of Israel.
  Thorns and thistles will grow up
    and cover their altars.
  Then they will say to the mountains, “Cover us!”
    and to the hills, “Fall on us!”

teaching.name: Israel will become an empty vine

content:
But you have planted wickedness,
    you have reaped evil,
    you have eaten the fruit of deception.
  Because you have depended on your own strength
    and on your many warriors,

teaching.name: Israel will become an empty vine

content:
the roar of battle will rise against your people,
    so that all your fortresses will be devastated—
  as Shalman devastated Beth Arbel on the day of battle,
    when mothers were dashed to the ground with their children.

teaching.name: Israel will become an empty vine

content:
Their heart is deceitful,
    and now they must bear their guilt.
  The Lord will demolish their altars
    and destroy their sacred stones.

teaching.name: Israel will become an empty vine
Israel will become an empty vine

content:
Ephraim is a trained heifer
    that loves to thresh;
  so I will put a yoke
    on her fair neck.
  I will drive Ephraim,
    Judah must plow,
    and Jacob must break up the ground.

teaching.name: Israel will become an empty vine
Israel will become an empty vine

content:
They make many promises,
    take false oaths
    and make agreements;
  therefore lawsuits spring up
    like poisonous weeds in a plowed field.

teaching.name: Israel will become an empty vine

content:
The people who live in Samaria fear
    for the calf-idol of Beth Aven.
  Its people will mourn over it,
    and so will its idolatrous priests,
  those who had rejoiced over its splendor,
    because it is taken from them into exile.

teaching.name: Israel will become an empty vine

content:
It will be carried to Assyria
    as tribute for the great king.
  Ephraim will be disgraced;
    Israel will be ashamed of its foreign alliances.

teaching.name: Israel will become an empty vine

content:
Samaria’s king will be destroyed,
    swept away like a twig on the surface of the waters.

teaching.name: Israel will become an empty vine

content:
“Since the days of Gibeah, you have sinned, Israel,
    and there you have remained.
  Will not war again overtake
    the evildoers in Gibeah?

teaching.name: Israel will become an empty vine

content:
So will it happen to you, Bethel,
    because your wickedness is great.
  When that day dawns,
    the king of Israel will be completely destroyed.

teaching.name: Israel will become an empty vine

content:
“When Israel was a child, I loved him,
    and out of Egypt I called my son.

teaching.name: God's love: love of a father to a child

content:
“How can I give you up, Ephraim?
    How can I hand you over, Israel?
  How can I treat you like Admah?
    How can I make you like Zeboyim?
  My heart is changed within me;
    all my compassion is aroused.

teaching.name: God's love: love of a father to a child
God's love: love of a father to a child

content:
I will not carry out my fierce anger,
    nor will I devastate Ephraim again.
  For I am God, and not a man—
    the Holy One among you.
    I will not come against their cities.

teaching.name: God's love: love of a father to a child

content:
They will follow the Lord;
    he will roar like a lion.
  When he roars,
    his children will come trembling from the west.

teaching.name: God's love: love of a father to a child

content:
But the more they were called,
    the more they went away from me.
  They sacrificed to the Baals
    and they burned incense to images.

teaching.name: God's love: love of a father to a child

content:
My people are determined to turn from me.
    Even though they call me God Most High,
    I will by no means exalt them.

teaching.name: God's love: love of a father to a child

content:
It was I who taught Ephraim to walk,
    taking them by the arms;
  but they did not realize
    it was I who healed them.

teaching.name: God's love: love of a father to a child

content:
I led them with cords of human kindness,
    with ties of love.
  To them I was like one who lifts
    a little child to the cheek,
    and I bent down to feed them.

teaching.name: God's love: love of a father to a child

content:
“Will they not return to Egypt
    and will not Assyria rule over them
    because they refuse to repent?

teaching.name: God's love: love of a father to a child

content:
They will come from Egypt,
    trembling like sparrows,
    from Assyria, fluttering like doves.
  I will settle them in their homes,”
    declares the Lord.

teaching.name: God's love: love of a father to a child

content:
Ephraim has surrounded me with lies,
    Israel with deceit.
  And Judah is unruly against God,
    even against the faithful Holy One.

teaching.name: God's love: love of a father to a child

content:
Ephraim feeds on the wind;
    he pursues the east wind all day
    and multiplies lies and violence.
  He makes a treaty with Assyria
    and sends olive oil to Egypt.

teaching.name: Israel must be judged but God will not give her up

content:
Is Gilead wicked?
    Its people are worthless!
  Do they sacrifice bulls in Gilgal?
    Their altars will be like piles of stones
    on a plowed field.

teaching.name: Israel must be judged but God will not give her up
Israel must be judged but God will not give her up

content:
the Lord God Almighty,
    the Lord is his name!

teaching.name: Israel must be judged but God will not give her up

content:
The merchant uses dishonest scales
    and loves to defraud.

teaching.name: Israel must be judged but God will not give her up

content:
The Lord used a prophet to bring Israel up from Egypt,
    by a prophet he cared for him.

teaching.name: Israel must be judged but God will not give her up

content:
In the womb he grasped his brother’s heel;
    as a man he struggled with God.

teaching.name: Israel must be judged but God will not give her up

content:
He struggled with the angel and overcame him;
    he wept and begged for his favor.
  He found him at Bethel
    and talked with him there—

teaching.name: Israel must be judged but God will not give her up
Israel must be judged but God will not give her up

content:
Ephraim boasts,
    “I am very rich; I have become wealthy.
  With all my wealth they will not find in me
    any iniquity or sin.”

teaching.name: Israel must be judged but God will not give her up

content:
“I have been the Lord your God
    ever since you came out of Egypt;
  I will make you live in tents again,
    as in the days of your appointed festivals.

teaching.name: Israel must be judged but God will not give her up
Israel must be judged but God will not give her up

content:
I spoke to the prophets,
    gave them many visions
    and told parables through them.”

teaching.name: Israel must be judged but God will not give her up
Israel must be judged but God will not give her up
Israel will be judged in the present

content:
The guilt of Ephraim is stored up,
    his sins are kept on record.

teaching.name: Israel will be judged in the present

content:
“But I have been the Lord your God
    ever since you came out of Egypt.
  You shall acknowledge no God but me,
    no Savior except me.

teaching.name: Israel will be judged in the present

content:
So I will be like a lion to them,
    like a leopard I will lurk by the path.

teaching.name: Israel will be judged in the present

content:
Like a bear robbed of her cubs,
    I will attack them and rip them open;
  like a lion I will devour them—
    a wild animal will tear them apart.

teaching.name: Israel will be judged in the present

content:
Pains as of a woman in childbirth come to him,
    but he is a child without wisdom;
  when the time arrives,
    he doesn’t have the sense to come out of the womb.

teaching.name: Israel will be judged in the present

content:
even though he thrives among his brothers.
  An east wind from the Lord will come,
    blowing in from the desert;
  his spring will fail
    and his well dry up.
  His storehouse will be plundered
    of all its treasures.

teaching.name: Israel will be judged in the present

content:
Now they sin more and more;
    they make idols for themselves from their silver,
  cleverly fashioned images,
    all of them the work of craftsmen.
  It is said of these people,
    “They offer human sacrifices!
    They kiss calf-idols!”

teaching.name: Israel will be judged in the present

content:
Therefore they will be like the morning mist,
    like the early dew that disappears,
    like chaff swirling from a threshing floor,
    like smoke escaping through a window.

teaching.name: Israel will be judged in the present

content:
I cared for you in the wilderness,
    in the land of burning heat.

teaching.name: Israel will be judged in the present

content:
“You are destroyed, Israel,
    because you are against me, against your helper.

teaching.name: Israel will be judged in the present

content:
“I will deliver this people from the power of the grave;
    I will redeem them from death.
  Where, O death, are your plagues?
    Where, O grave, is your destruction?
    
  “I will have no compassion,

teaching.name: Israel will be judged in the present

content:
The people of Samaria must bear their guilt,
    because they have rebelled against their God.
  They will fall by the sword;
    their little ones will be dashed to the ground,
    their pregnant women ripped open.”

teaching.name: Israel will be judged in the present
Israel will be judged in the present

content:
Where is your king, that he may save you?
    Where are your rulers in all your towns,
  of whom you said,
    ‘Give me a king and princes’?

teaching.name: Israel will be judged in the present

content:
So in my anger I gave you a king,
    and in my wrath I took him away.

teaching.name: Israel will be judged in the present

content:
his young shoots will grow.
  His splendor will be like an olive tree,
    his fragrance like a cedar of Lebanon.

teaching.name: Israel's salvation in the future

content:
People will dwell again in his shade;
    they will flourish like the grain,
  they will blossom like the vine—
    Israel’s fame will be like the wine of Lebanon.

teaching.name: Israel's salvation in the future

content:
Who is wise? Let them realize these things.
    Who is discerning? Let them understand.
  The ways of the Lord are right;
    the righteous walk in them,
    but the rebellious stumble in them.

teaching.name: Israel's salvation in the future

content:
Return, Israel, to the Lord your God.
    Your sins have been your downfall!

teaching.name: Israel's salvation in the future

content:
Take words with you
    and return to the Lord.
  Say to him:
    “Forgive all our sins
  and receive us graciously,
    that we may offer the fruit of our lips.

teaching.name: Israel's salvation in the future

content:
Assyria cannot save us;
    we will not mount warhorses.
  We will never again say ‘Our gods’
    to what our own hands have made,
    for in you the fatherless find compassion.”

teaching.name: Israel's salvation in the future

content:
Ephraim, what more have I to do with idols?
    I will answer him and care for him.
  I am like a flourishing juniper;
    your fruitfulness comes from me.”

teaching.name: Israel's salvation in the future
Israel's salvation in the future

content:
“I will heal their waywardness
    and love them freely,
    for my anger has turned away from them.

teaching.name: Israel's salvation in the future

content:
I will remove the names of the Baals from her lips;
    no longer will their names be invoked.

teaching.name: Gomer and Israel prove faithless

content:
“In that day I will respond,”
    declares the Lord—
  “I will respond to the skies,
    and they will respond to the earth;

teaching.name: Gomer and Israel prove faithless

content:
and the earth will respond to the grain,
    the new wine and the olive oil,
    and they will respond to Jezreel.

teaching.name: Gomer and Israel prove faithless

content:
“Rebuke your mother, rebuke her,
    for she is not my wife,
    and I am not her husband.
  Let her remove the adulterous look from her face
    and the unfaithfulness from between her breasts.

teaching.name: Gomer and Israel prove faithless

content:
Otherwise I will strip her naked
    and make her as bare as on the day she was born;
  I will make her like a desert,
    turn her into a parched land,
    and slay her with thirst.

teaching.name: Gomer and Israel prove faithless

content:
I will not show my love to her children,
    because they are the children of adultery.

teaching.name: Gomer and Israel prove faithless

content:
Therefore I will block her path with thornbushes;
    I will wall her in so that she cannot find her way.

teaching.name: Gomer and Israel prove faithless

content:
She has not acknowledged that I was the one
    who gave her the grain, the new wine and oil,
  who lavished on her the silver and gold—
    which they used for Baal.

teaching.name: Gomer and Israel prove faithless

content:
“Therefore I will take away my grain when it ripens,
    and my new wine when it is ready.
  I will take back my wool and my linen,
    intended to cover her naked body.

teaching.name: Gomer and Israel prove faithless

content:
I will stop all her celebrations:
    her yearly festivals, her New Moons,
    her Sabbath days—all her appointed festivals.

teaching.name: Gomer and Israel prove faithless
Gomer and Israel prove faithless
Gomer and Israel prove faithless

content:
In that day I will make a covenant for them
    with the beasts of the field, the birds in the sky
    and the creatures that move along the ground.
  Bow and sword and battle
    I will abolish from the land,
    so that all may lie down in safety.

teaching.name: Gomer and Israel prove faithless

content:
I will betroth you in faithfulness,
    and you will acknowledge the Lord.

teaching.name: Gomer and Israel prove faithless

content: “Say of your brothers, ‘My people,’ and of your sisters, ‘My loved one.’

teaching.name: Gomer and Israel prove faithless

content:
She will chase after her lovers but not catch them;
    she will look for them but not find them.
  Then she will say,
    ‘I will go back to my husband as at first,
    for then I was better off than now.’

teaching.name: Gomer and Israel prove faithless
Gomer and Israel prove faithless

content:
I will ruin her vines and her fig trees,
    which she said were her pay from her lovers;
  I will make them a thicket,
    and wild animals will devour them.

teaching.name: Gomer and Israel prove faithless

content:
I will punish her for the days
    she burned incense to the Baals;
  she decked herself with rings and jewelry,
    and went after her lovers,
    but me she forgot,” declares the Lord.

teaching.name: Gomer and Israel prove faithless
Gomer and Israel prove faithless

content:
Their mother has been unfaithful
    and has conceived them in disgrace.
  She said, ‘I will go after my lovers,
    who give me my food and my water,
    my wool and my linen, my olive oil and my drink.’

teaching.name: Gomer and Israel prove faithless

content:
There I will give her back her vineyards,
    and will make the Valley of Achor a door of hope.
  There she will respond as in the days of her youth,
    as in the day she came up out of Egypt.

teaching.name: Gomer and Israel prove faithless
Gomer and Israel prove faithless

content: For the Israelites will live many days without king or prince, without sacrifice or sacred stones, without ephod or household gods.

teaching.name: Israel is guilty before God

content: The Lord said to me, “Go, show your love to your wife again, though she is loved by another man and is an adulteress. Love her as the Lord loves the Israelites, though they turn to other gods and love the sacred raisin cakes.”

teaching.name: Israel is guilty before God

content: Afterward the Israelites will return and seek the Lord their God and David their king. They will come trembling to the Lord and to his blessings in the last days.

teaching.name: Israel is guilty before God

content: So I bought her for fifteen shekels of silver and about a homer and a lethek of barley.

teaching.name: Israel is guilty before God

content: Then I told her, “You are to live with me many days; you must not be a prostitute or be intimate with any man, and I will behave the same way toward you.”

teaching.name: Israel is guilty before God

content:
You stumble day and night,
    and the prophets stumble with you.
  So I will destroy your mother—

teaching.name: Israel is guilty before God

content:
My people consult a wooden idol,
    and a diviner’s rod speaks to them.
  A spirit of prostitution leads them astray;
    they are unfaithful to their God.

teaching.name: Introduction of the prophetic book of Hosea

content:
Because of this the land dries up,
    and all who live in it waste away;
  the beasts of the field, the birds in the sky
    and the fish in the sea are swept away.

teaching.name: Israel is guilty before God
Introduction of the prophetic book of Hosea

content:
They feed on the sins of my people
    and relish their wickedness.

teaching.name: Introduction of the prophetic book of Hosea

content:
“They will eat but not have enough;
    they will engage in prostitution but not flourish,
  because they have deserted the Lord
    to give themselves

teaching.name: Introduction of the prophetic book of Hosea

content:
They sacrifice on the mountaintops
    and burn offerings on the hills,
  under oak, poplar and terebinth,
    where the shade is pleasant.
  Therefore your daughters turn to prostitution
    and your daughters-in-law to adultery.

teaching.name: Introduction of the prophetic book of Hosea

content:
“Though you, Israel, commit adultery,
    do not let Judah become guilty.
    
  “Do not go to Gilgal;
    do not go up to Beth Aven.
    And do not swear, ‘As surely as the Lord lives!’

teaching.name: Introduction of the prophetic book of Hosea

content:
Hear the word of the Lord, you Israelites,
    because the Lord has a charge to bring
    against you who live in the land:
  “There is no faithfulness, no love,
    no acknowledgment of God in the land.

teaching.name: Israel is guilty before God

content:
There is only cursing, lying and murder,
    stealing and adultery;
  they break all bounds,
    and bloodshed follows bloodshed.

teaching.name: Israel is guilty before God

content:
And it will be: Like people, like priests.
    I will punish both of them for their ways
    and repay them for their deeds.

teaching.name: Introduction of the prophetic book of Hosea
Introduction of the prophetic book of Hosea

content:
“I will not punish your daughters
    when they turn to prostitution,
  nor your daughters-in-law
    when they commit adultery,
  because the men themselves consort with harlots
    and sacrifice with shrine prostitutes—
    a people without understanding will come to ruin!

teaching.name: Introduction of the prophetic book of Hosea

content:
The Israelites are stubborn,
    like a stubborn heifer.
  How then can the Lord pasture them
    like lambs in a meadow?

teaching.name: Introduction of the prophetic book of Hosea
Introduction of the prophetic book of Hosea

content:
“But let no one bring a charge,
    let no one accuse another,
  for your people are like those
    who bring charges against a priest.

teaching.name: Israel is guilty before God

content:
my people are destroyed from lack of knowledge.
    
  “Because you have rejected knowledge,
    I also reject you as my priests;
  because you have ignored the law of your God,
    I also will ignore your children.

teaching.name: Introduction of the prophetic book of Hosea

content:
Ephraim is joined to idols;
    leave him alone!

teaching.name: Introduction of the prophetic book of Hosea

content:
A whirlwind will sweep them away,
    and their sacrifices will bring them shame.

teaching.name: Introduction of the prophetic book of Hosea
Israel turns from God and God turns from Israel

content:
“Their deeds do not permit them
    to return to their God.
  A spirit of prostitution is in their heart;
    they do not acknowledge the Lord.

teaching.name: Israel turns from God and God turns from Israel

content:
“Sound the trumpet in Gibeah,
    the horn in Ramah.
  Raise the battle cry in Beth Aven;
    lead on, Benjamin.

teaching.name: Israel turns from God and God turns from Israel

content:
Ephraim is oppressed,
    trampled in judgment,
    intent on pursuing idols.

teaching.name: Israel turns from God and God turns from Israel

content:
I am like a moth to Ephraim,
    like rot to the people of Judah.

teaching.name: Israel turns from God and God turns from Israel

content:
Then I will return to my lair
    until they have borne their guilt
    and seek my face—
  in their misery
    they will earnestly seek me.”

teaching.name: Israel turns from God and God turns from Israel

content:
For I will be like a lion to Ephraim,
    like a great lion to Judah.
  I will tear them to pieces and go away;
    I will carry them off, with no one to rescue them.

teaching.name: Israel turns from God and God turns from Israel

content:
When they go with their flocks and herds
    to seek the Lord,
  they will not find him;
    he has withdrawn himself from them.

teaching.name: Israel turns from God and God turns from Israel

content:
Judah’s leaders are like those
    who move boundary stones.
  I will pour out my wrath on them
    like a flood of water.

teaching.name: Israel turns from God and God turns from Israel

content:
“Hear this, you priests!
    Pay attention, you Israelites!
  Listen, royal house!
    This judgment is against you:
  You have been a snare at Mizpah,
    a net spread out on Tabor.

teaching.name: Israel turns from God and God turns from Israel

content:
The rebels are knee-deep in slaughter.
    I will discipline all of them.

teaching.name: Israel turns from God and God turns from Israel
Israel turns from God and God turns from Israel

content:
They are unfaithful to the Lord;
    they give birth to illegitimate children.
  When they celebrate their New Moon feasts,
    he will devour their fields.

teaching.name: Israel turns from God and God turns from Israel

content:
Ephraim will be laid waste
    on the day of reckoning.
  Among the tribes of Israel
    I proclaim what is certain.

teaching.name: Israel turns from God and God turns from Israel

content:
“When Ephraim saw his sickness,
    and Judah his sores,
  then Ephraim turned to Assyria,
    and sent to the great king for help.
  But he is not able to cure you,
    not able to heal your sores.

teaching.name: Israel turns from God and God turns from Israel

content:
As at Adam, they have broken the covenant;
    they were unfaithful to me there.

teaching.name: Israel's return in the last days

content:
“Also for you, Judah,
    a harvest is appointed.
    
  “Whenever I would restore the fortunes of my people,

teaching.name: Israel's return in the last days

content:
“Come, let us return to the Lord.
  He has torn us to pieces
    but he will heal us;
  he has injured us
    but he will bind up our wounds.

teaching.name: Israel's return in the last days
Israel's return in the last days

content:
“What can I do with you, Ephraim?
    What can I do with you, Judah?
  Your love is like the morning mist,
    like the early dew that disappears.

teaching.name: Israel's return in the last days

content:
Therefore I cut you in pieces with my prophets,
    I killed you with the words of my mouth—
    then my judgments go forth like the sun.

teaching.name: Israel's return in the last days
Israel's return in the last days

content:
For I desire mercy, not sacrifice,
    and acknowledgment of God rather than burnt offerings.

teaching.name: Israel's return in the last days

content:
Gilead is a city of evildoers,
    stained with footprints of blood.

teaching.name: Israel's return in the last days

content:
As marauders lie in ambush for a victim,
    so do bands of priests;
  they murder on the road to Shechem,
    carrying out their wicked schemes.

teaching.name: Israel's return in the last days

content:
I have seen a horrible thing in Israel:
    There Ephraim is given to prostitution,
    Israel is defiled.

teaching.name: Israel's return in the last days

content:
They are all adulterers,
    burning like an oven
  whose fire the baker need not stir
    from the kneading of the dough till it rises.

teaching.name: Israel turns to Egypt and Assyria

content:
“Ephraim mixes with the nations;
    Ephraim is a flat loaf not turned over.

teaching.name: Israel turns to Egypt and Assyria

content:
but they do not realize
    that I remember all their evil deeds.
  Their sins engulf them;
    they are always before me.

teaching.name: Israel turns to Egypt and Assyria

content:
“They delight the king with their wickedness,
    the princes with their lies.

teaching.name: Israel turns to Egypt and Assyria

content:
Woe to them,
    because they have strayed from me!
  Destruction to them,
    because they have rebelled against me!
  I long to redeem them
    but they speak about me falsely.

teaching.name: Israel turns to Egypt and Assyria

content:
They do not cry out to me from their hearts
    but wail on their beds.
  They slash themselves, appealing to their gods
    for grain and new wine,
    but they turn away from me.

teaching.name: Israel turns to Egypt and Assyria

content:
I trained them and strengthened their arms,
    but they plot evil against me.

teaching.name: Israel turns to Egypt and Assyria

content:
They do not turn to the Most High;
    they are like a faulty bow.
  Their leaders will fall by the sword
    because of their insolent words.
  For this they will be ridiculed
    in the land of Egypt.

teaching.name: Israel turns to Egypt and Assyria

content:
whenever I would heal Israel,
  the sins of Ephraim are exposed
    and the crimes of Samaria revealed.
  They practice deceit,
    thieves break into houses,
    bandits rob in the streets;

teaching.name: Israel turns to Egypt and Assyria

content:
On the day of the festival of our king
    the princes become inflamed with wine,
    and he joins hands with the mockers.

teaching.name: Israel turns to Egypt and Assyria

content:
All of them are hot as an oven;
    they devour their rulers.
  All their kings fall,
    and none of them calls on me.

teaching.name: Israel turns to Egypt and Assyria

content:
“Ephraim is like a dove,
    easily deceived and senseless—
  now calling to Egypt,
    now turning to Assyria.

teaching.name: Israel turns to Egypt and Assyria
Israel turns to Egypt and Assyria

content:
Foreigners sap his strength,
    but he does not realize it.
  His hair is sprinkled with gray,
    but he does not notice.

teaching.name: Israel turns to Egypt and Assyria

content:
Israel’s arrogance testifies against him,
    but despite all this
  he does not return to the Lord his God
    or search for him.

teaching.name: Israel turns to Egypt and Assyria

content:
When they go, I will throw my net over them;
    I will pull them down like the birds in the sky.
  When I hear them flocking together,
    I will catch them.

teaching.name: Israel turns to Egypt and Assyria

content:
“Put the trumpet to your lips!
    An eagle is over the house of the Lord
  because the people have broken my covenant
    and rebelled against my law.

teaching.name: Israel turns to golden calves and altars of sin

content:
Israel has forgotten their Maker
    and built palaces;
    Judah has fortified many towns.
  But I will send fire on their cities
    that will consume their fortresses.”

teaching.name: Israel turns to golden calves and altars of sin

content:
Samaria, throw out your calf-idol!
    My anger burns against them.
  How long will they be incapable of purity?

teaching.name: Israel turns to golden calves and altars of sin

content:
They are from Israel!
  This calf—a metalworker has made it;
    it is not God.
  It will be broken in pieces,
    that calf of Samaria.

teaching.name: Israel turns to golden calves and altars of sin

content:
“They sow the wind
    and reap the whirlwind.
  The stalk has no head;
    it will produce no flour.
  Were it to yield grain,
    foreigners would swallow it up.

teaching.name: Israel turns to golden calves and altars of sin

content:
Israel cries out to me,
    ‘Our God, we acknowledge you!’

teaching.name: Israel turns to golden calves and altars of sin

content:
But Israel has rejected what is good;
    an enemy will pursue him.

teaching.name: Israel turns to golden calves and altars of sin

content:
“Though Ephraim built many altars for sin offerings,
    these have become altars for sinning.

teaching.name: Israel turns to golden calves and altars of sin

content:
I wrote for them the many things of my law,
    but they regarded them as something foreign.

teaching.name: Israel turns to golden calves and altars of sin

content:
Though they offer sacrifices as gifts to me,
    and though they eat the meat,
    the Lord is not pleased with them.
  Now he will remember their wickedness
    and punish their sins:
    They will return to Egypt.

teaching.name: Israel turns to golden calves and altars of sin

content:
They set up kings without my consent;
    they choose princes without my approval.
  With their silver and gold
    they make idols for themselves
    to their own destruction.

teaching.name: Israel turns to golden calves and altars of sin
Israel turns to golden calves and altars of sin

content:
For they have gone up to Assyria
    like a wild donkey wandering alone.
    Ephraim has sold herself to lovers.

teaching.name: Israel turns to golden calves and altars of sin

content:
Although they have sold themselves among the nations,
    I will now gather them together.
  They will begin to waste away
    under the oppression of the mighty king.

teaching.name: Israel turns to golden calves and altars of sin
Israel turning to land prosperity

content:
I have seen Ephraim, like Tyre,
    planted in a pleasant place.
  But Ephraim will bring out
    their children to the slayer.”

teaching.name: Israel turning to land prosperity

content:
Ephraim is blighted,
    their root is withered,
    they yield no fruit.
  Even if they bear children,
    I will slay their cherished offspring.”

teaching.name: Israel turning to land prosperity
Israel turning to land prosperity

content:
Threshing floors and winepresses will not feed the people;
    the new wine will fail them.

teaching.name: Israel turning to land prosperity

content:
The days of punishment are coming,
    the days of reckoning are at hand.
    Let Israel know this.
  Because your sins are so many
    and your hostility so great,
  the prophet is considered a fool,
    the inspired person a maniac.

teaching.name: Israel turning to land prosperity

content:
They have sunk deep into corruption,
    as in the days of Gibeah.
  God will remember their wickedness
    and punish them for their sins.

teaching.name: Israel turning to land prosperity

content:
Even if they rear children,
    I will bereave them of every one.
  Woe to them
    when I turn away from them!

teaching.name: Israel turning to land prosperity

content:
“Because of all their wickedness in Gilgal,
    I hated them there.
  Because of their sinful deeds,
    I will drive them out of my house.
  I will no longer love them;
    all their leaders are rebellious.

teaching.name: Israel turning to land prosperity
Israel turning to land prosperity

content:
Even if they escape from destruction,
    Egypt will gather them,
    and Memphis will bury them.
  Their treasures of silver will be taken over by briers,
    and thorns will overrun their tents.

teaching.name: Israel turning to land prosperity

content:
The prophet, along with my God,
    is the watchman over Ephraim,
  yet snares await him on all his paths,
    and hostility in the house of his God.

teaching.name: Israel turning to land prosperity

content:
Give them, Lord—
    what will you give them?
  Give them wombs that miscarry
    and breasts that are dry.

teaching.name: Israel turning to land prosperity
Israel turning to land prosperity

content:
What will you do on the day of your appointed festivals,
    on the feast days of the Lord?

teaching.name: Israel turning to land prosperity

content:
“When I found Israel,
    it was like finding grapes in the desert;
  when I saw your ancestors,
    it was like seeing the early fruit on the fig tree.
  But when they came to Baal Peor,
    they consecrated themselves to that shameful idol
    and became as vile as the thing they loved.

teaching.name: Israel turning to land prosperity

content:
Ephraim’s glory will fly away like a bird—
    no birth, no pregnancy, no conception.

teaching.name: Israel turning to land prosperity
